verdict: PASS for scoped ETH aggregate funding component; no integration performed and no full G04 acceptance
sourceVerification: All six working files hash-match handoff and exact candidate Git blobs; only six claimed paths differ from base. Root unfinished journal/application edits excluded.
review: Signed depositFor uses OpenZeppelin EIP712 and SignatureChecker; chain/portal domain and beneficiary/executor/amount/secretHash/nonce/deadline are bound. Nonce advances before shared deposit logic and reverts on failure. Direct deposit remains unchanged; storage, L1-to-L2 message and withdrawal ownership remain beneficiary.

Router requires beneficiary==msg.sender and exact ETH value. Fixed constructor scope binds chain, common rollup bridges/version, tokens and FPC. Exact-output swap recipient is the router; both reported spent and actual WETH/output deltas are checked. Approvals reset to zero after swaps and portal deposits.

All swaps, three deposits, portal consent nonce, and refund are within one nonReentrant transaction. Failure of any leg or refund reverts all effects. PluginPortal separately verifies exact incoming token delta. Fee portal incoming and router outgoing balances are both checked. Forced ETH and donated WETH are preserved, not refunded as user funds.
Refund returns only unused per-plan input to authenticated sender/beneficiary; no sweep/admin/mint/arbitrary-call path. Collateral remains refundable through original beneficiary-only portal exit.

Quote preparation captures primitive inputs before await; verifies current chain, fresh canonical quote block, pinned router/quoter runtime hashes, exact router scope and portal availability, allocation/min/max, two fixed QuoterV2 exact-output reads, slippage ceiling, sender balance plus declared gas budget, and elapsed quote time. Result is immutable/branded and explicitly ready:false.

Quote canonicality is not L1 funding finality or bridge delivery. Transaction encoder validates local plan brand/deadline and declares reconcile-only but does not itself enforce sending or recovery. Caller must capture current wallet chain/address and journal exact calldata/value before a single send.

The consent signature authorizes collateral for a specific executor; the beneficiary transaction binds remaining allocation and Bok commitment. It is not an independent signature over the complete aggregate plan. Parent integration must retain exact plan and distinguish portal consent nonce from Ethereum transaction nonce.
